user_query: I'm organizing a music-themed event and I need to create a promotional flyer. Can you suggest some catchy phrases and quotes related to music? Also, provide me with the U.K. Songs chart information to feature the current popular songs.

TaskList.description: Collect catchy phrases and quotes related to music for the promotional flyer.
Fetch the current U.K. Songs chart information to feature popular songs.
Combine the catchy phrases/quotes with the U.K. Songs chart information to create a promotional flyer.
